summary: Associate Vice President, Investment Strategist candidate with ~7 years across multi-asset portfolio analytics, macroeconomic research and scenario analysis, and asset allocation advisory. Delivers duration, yield curve, and credit-exposure analysis and translates it into investment-committee-ready narratives at Moody's Analytics, holding delegated sign-off on outputs for institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement). Prior LDI and strategic asset allocation advisory for Canadian pension funds at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc in Financial Modelling and Chemical Engineering.
core_skills: Fixed Income, Duration & Yield Curve Analytics

sections.heading: Investment Strategy & Portfolio Analytics
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio-level outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative) - independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions.

Analyzed portfolio exposures and risks - duration positioning, yield-curve sensitivity, credit and cross-asset exposures, and security- to portfolio-level aggregation - across multi-asset institutional mandates.
Validated derivatives outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.

sections.heading: Macroeconomic Research & Scenario Analysis
bullets: Designed and delivered a multi-scenario cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, embedding macro stress overlays and behavioural assumptions.
Built time-bucketed liquidity and exposure analytics (T+1 through multi-year) informing funding, refinancing, and asset-allocation decisions.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines feeding recurring charts and dashboards used across delivery teams.

sections.heading: Investment Communication & Stakeholder Engagement
bullets: Prepared and delivered analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities - translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready narratives.
Served as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform, translating investment-team requirements into configuration and validation work.
Advised clients on asset, liability, and allocation configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.

Advised Canadian and international pension funds on Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis - presenting findings to investment committees on-site.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk, funding volatility, and market cycles under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, attribution, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis - trade-offs across return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity - and cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, coordinating across actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions.
Developed advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral, and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
